text: DSH Wallpaper 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的壁纸插件，通过对话输入栏的美化面板把自选图片、视频或六种渐变设为界面背景，并调整遮罩、模糊、填充方式和面板透明度。它将壁纸层放在页面内容下方，并调整界面表面色，让对话框等交互区域保持可读。适合想自定义 DSH 网页外观的用户；无需 API 密钥或外部服务，素材和设置保存在当前浏览器中。

DSH Wallpaper adds an image, video, or gradient background to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. Open its composer dock panel to adjust veil, blur, fill, and surface opacity while keeping dialogs readable. Media and settings stay in this browser; no API key or external service is needed.
想把自己选的图片或视频设成 DSH 网页的背景。
怎么让聊天界面半透明，同时别让弹窗文字看不清？
Can I add a soft, blurred background to the chat UI and choose how it is cropped?
DSH Wallpaper 的功能「自选媒体壁纸」：在对话输入栏打开美化面板，选择本地图片或视频作为背景，也可使用六种渐变预设；视频静音循环播放。
DSH Wallpaper 的功能「壁纸外观调节」：在面板中调节遮罩、模糊、界面表面透明度和图片填充方式；弹窗等交互区域保留较高不透明度以维持可读性。
dsh-plugin-wallpaper 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 6 天；提交数 1；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。
dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · Wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness：

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · Wallpaper for DeepSeek Harness：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) UI plugin that turns the whole
interface into your own wallpaper: import an image or a video, tune veil / blur / fill, and let the
Harness surfaces turn to glass. Dialogs, approval prompts and the Settings page automatically keep a
readable body.

**[中文说明 →](README.zh-CN.md)**

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · Features：- **Your own media** — import any image (`image/*`) or video (`video/*`, plays muted and looped) with
  the native file picker. Both live in this browser only.
- **Glass surfaces** — the shell (frame, sidebar, title bar) becomes fully transparent, so the media is
  the interface, not a strip behind it.
- **One slider for readability** — "Surface opacity" controls how much body ambient surfaces
  (bubbles, composer, tints) keep; `0%` is pure wallpaper, `100%` is the stock white card look.
- **Interactive surfaces never wash out** — dialogs, question cards, approval prompts, menus, popovers
  and toasts keep at least 88% body; the Settings page is forced fully opaque.
- **Six gradient presets** — beautify with zero files, or use them as a fallback.
- **Veil + blur + fill** — dim the media per colour scheme (white veil in light mode, black in dark),
  blur it 0–24 px, and pick `cover` or `contain`.
- **Persistent** — the media (IndexedDB) and the settings (localStorage) survive reloads and restarts.
- **No upload** — nothing leaves the machine; there is no network call in the plugin.

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI. Built and tested on `0.2.2-rc.1` (desktop and `dsh web`).
- Any OS the Harness Web UI runs on. No build step, no dependencies, no install scripts.

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · Install：The plugin is a Harness *bundle*: one `cordis.patch.yml` row plus a browser module. Install it from a
checkout of this repository:

```bash
git clone <repository-url>
```

Then pick one:

**A. In the app** — open **Plugins** in the left sidebar, choose install from a local directory, and
point it at the cloned folder.

**B. With an agent session** — ask the Harness agent to install the bundle, or call the plugin manager
tool with the absolute path:

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · Install：```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "D:\\path\\to\\dsh-plugin-wallpaper" }
```

**C. With the CLI** — from a Harness checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-wallpaper
```

The bundle activates through HMR. If the page still shows the previous build, reload the page (or
restart the app) once — the browser keeps client modules per graph revision.

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · Usage：1. Open any session and find the **Wallpaper** pill at the right end of the composer dock
   (next to the round/token counters).
2. In the panel:
   - **Image / Video** — pick a file. It applies immediately and is remembered.
   - **Presets** — six gradients, useful before you have media.
   - **Veil** — the dim layer over the media (white in light mode, black in dark).
   - **Blur** — 0–24 px; the media is scaled up slightly so blur never shows edges.
   - **Surface opacity** — body of ambient surfaces; dialogs keep their own readability floor.
   - **Fill** — `Cover` or `Fit`.
   - **Enable wallpaper** — temporary off switch that keeps the media.
   - **Reset all** — clears media and settings.
3. The dot on the pill marks an active wallpaper.

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · Where files live：| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Image / video blobs | IndexedDB `dsh-beautify`, object store `media`, keys `image` / `video` |
| Settings | `localStorage["dsh-beautify/settings/v1"]` |

Limit: 200 MB per file. Nothing is uploaded — the plugin makes no network requests.

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · How it works：- **Host half** (`index.js`) is intentionally empty; all behaviour is in the browser module
  (`client.js`).
- A fixed `#dsh-beautify-wall` layer is inserted as the first child of `document.body` with
  `z-index: -1`, so it paints above the page canvas and below all interface content.
- `ctx.theme.overrideTokens()` redirects the design-system surface tokens: shell tokens become
  transparent, ambient tokens use the slider value, and interactive tokens get a readability floor.
  The root canvas is painted with the media's fallback colour so the page can never end up
  transparent-and-empty.
- Overrides are re-applied with the same source name when the slider moves (the theme service replaces
  a source's whole layer), and removed on unload.
- Dialogs are detected with `[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"], [role="alertdialog"]`; the Settings
  frame is recognised by its `navTitle` class and forced fully opaque. A `MutationObserver` plus
  `requestAnimationFrame` coalescing keeps this cheap while the chat streams.
- Media elements are reused per `(source, url)`. The early version rebuilt them on every theme publish
  and could exhaust the rend

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Fix |
|---|---|
| Pill is missing | The bundle is not active: enable it in **Plugins**. |
| Nothing changes after an update | Reload the page (or restart the app) so the browser fetches the new client module. |
| Text hard to read over a bright image | Raise **Veil**, or raise **Surface opacity**. |
| Video stutters / high CPU | Lower the blur to 0, or use an image instead of a video. |
| "The file is too large" | The per-file limit is 200 MB. |
| Wallpaper gone after clearing site data | Media lives in this browser; import it again. |

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · Uninstall：Disable or remove `Wallpaper` in the **Plugins** page, or drop `dsh-plugin-wallpaper` from the profile's
`dsh.profile.bundles`. The browser data stays behind; use **Reset all** in the panel first if you want
it gone.

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · Development：No build step. Files are served as-is.

```bash
node --check client.js   # syntax
node --check index.js
```

CI runs the same two checks plus a manifest JSON parse (`.github/workflows/check.yml`).

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · DeepSeek Harness 壁纸插件：

一个 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 界面插件：把整个 Web 界面换成 你自己的图片或视频壁纸，可调遮罩、模糊、填充与面板透明度；对话框、审批弹窗和设置页会自动保持可读底色。 **[English →](README.md)**

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · 功能：- **用自己的素材**：原生文件选择框导入任意图片（`image/*`）或视频（`video/*`，静音循环播放）。素材只存在本机浏览器。
- **界面玻璃化**：外壳（框架、侧栏、标题栏）完全透明，图片就是界面本身，而不是界面后面的一条。
- **一个可读性滑杆**：`面板不透明度` 控制气泡、输入框等"环境表面"保留多少底色；`0%` 是纯壁纸，`100%` 回到原来的白卡。
- **交互表面不会被冲淡**：对话框、提问卡片、权限申请、菜单、浮层、提示条至少保留 88% 底色；设置页强制完全不透明。
- **6 套渐变预设**：没有素材时也能先美化。
- **遮罩 / 模糊 / 填充**：遮罩跟随明暗主题（浅色用白色、深色用黑色），模糊 0–24px，填充支持铺满/适应。
- **持久化**：素材存 IndexedDB、设置存 localStorage，刷新和重启后自动恢复。
- **不上传**：插件内没有任何网络请求。

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · 环境要求：- 带 Web UI 的 DeepSeek Harness，在 `0.2.2-rc.1` 上开发与验证（桌面端与 `dsh web`）。
- 无构建步骤、无第三方依赖、无安装脚本。

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · 安装：插件是一个 Harness bundle：一行 `cordis.patch.yml` 加一个浏览器模块。先克隆仓库：

```bash
git clone <repository-url>
```

然后任选一种：

**A. 应用内**——左侧「插件」页选择从本地目录安装，指向克隆下来的目录。

**B. 让 agent 装**——让 Harness agent 安装该 bundle，或调用插件管理工具并给出绝对路径：

```json
{ "action": "install_bundle", "target": "D:\\path\\to\\dsh-plugin-wallpaper" }
```

**C. 命令**——在 Harness checkout 里：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-wallpaper
```

安装通过 HMR 生效。如果页面还是旧构建，刷新一次页面（或重启应用）即可——浏览器按模块图版本缓存客户端模块。

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · 使用：1. 打开任意会话，在输入框下方那排最右侧找到 **美化** 按钮。
2. 面板里：
   - **图片 / 视频**：选文件，立刻生效并记住；
   - **预设渐变**：6 套配色；
   - **遮罩**：压在素材上的那层（浅色主题白色、深色主题黑色）；
   - **模糊**：0–24px，素材会自动放大一点避免边缘露白；
   - **面板不透明度**：环境表面的底色浓度，弹窗有独立可读性下限；
   - **填充**：铺满 / 适应；
   - **启用壁纸**：临时开关，素材保留；
   - **全部重置**：清空素材与设置。
3. 按钮上的圆点表示壁纸正在生效。

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · 数据存在哪：| 内容 | 位置 |
|---|---|
| 图片 / 视频 Blob | IndexedDB `dsh-beautify`，对象仓库 `media`，键 `image` / `video` |
| 设置 | `localStorage["dsh-beautify/settings/v1"]` |

单文件上限 200 MB，不会上传。

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · 实现要点：- **Host 半边**（`index.js`）是空的，全部逻辑在浏览器模块 `client.js`。
- 壁纸层 `#dsh-beautify-wall` 挂在 `document.body` 首位，`position: fixed; z-index: -1`，画在页面画布之上、界面内容之下。
- 通过 `ctx.theme.overrideTokens()` 接管设计系统的表面色 token：外壳透明、环境表面跟滑杆、交互表面有可读性下限；同时把根画布涂成素材兜底色，避免"透明露底"。
- 滑杆变化时用同一 source 重新下发（主题服务会整层替换），卸载时撤销。
- 用 `[role="dialog"][aria-modal="true"], [role="alertdialog"]` 找弹窗；设置页靠 `navTitle` 类名识别并强制不透明。监听用 `MutationObserver` + `requestAnimationFrame` 合并，聊天流式输出不会反复重扫。
- 媒体元素按 `(source, url)` 复用。早期版本在每次主题广播时重建元素，会把渲染进程的 WebMediaPlayer 耗尽；现版本只保留一个，并对 `theme/change → overrideTokens` 的重入做了守卫。

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · 常见问题：| 现象 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 找不到 美化 按钮 | bundle 没启用，去「插件」页打开。 |
| 更新后没变化 | 刷新页面或重启应用，让浏览器重新拉取客户端模块。 |
| 亮图上文字看不清 | 调高「遮罩」或「面板不透明度」。 |
| 视频卡顿 / 占 CPU | 把「模糊」降到 0，或改用图片。 |
| 提示文件太大 | 单文件上限 200 MB。 |
| 清理浏览器数据后壁纸没了 | 素材存在本机浏览器，重新导入即可。 |

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · 卸载：在「插件」页关闭或移除 `Wallpaper`，或从 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 删掉 `dsh-plugin-wallpaper`。
浏览器数据仍会保留，介意的话先在面板里点「全部重置」。

dsh-plugin-wallpaper README · 开发：无需构建：

```bash
node --check client.js
node --check index.js
```

CI 会跑同样的检查加一次清单 JSON 解析（见 `.github/workflows/check.yml`）。
